The values of all the indicators

Source: R/fct_change.R
all_values.Rd

Every value of every indicator of the countries in indicators(), for the countries of the app and the EU-27, as of the day data-raw/build_values.R wrote them into the package (the built attribute). The Change (%) tab compares all the indicators of a country between two years, which needs them all at once; the other tabs download the indicator they show from Eurostat, and so have the latest values.

Usage

all_values()

Value

A data frame with id (the indicator), geo (the Eurostat code of the country), year and value, or NULL when the package has no values.

Examples

values <- all_values()
attr(values, "built")
#> [1] "2026-11-15"
head(values)
#>        id geo year value
#> 1 gdp_pps  AL 1997  14.7
#> 2 gdp_pps  AL 1998  15.6
#> 3 gdp_pps  AL 1999  17.1
#> 4 gdp_pps  AL 2000  18.1
#> 5 gdp_pps  AL 2001  19.3
#> 6 gdp_pps  AL 2002  20.1
